reviewer_role: VIEW fixture author and cross-author interface reviewer. Root subsequently assigned this reviewer implementation ownership of qualify_saved.py; that wrapper portion is therefore implementation self-review. The semantic saved-evidence author and root independently read the final wrapper.

checks.finding: Every direct top-level run key accessed by the final verifier is emitted by the final qual_driver result dict. Canonical process_cleanup/owner_close/actor_pid are used. Optional cleanup/actual_owner_pid aliases must agree.

The wrapper binds transport status, three initialize/list/active MCP requests, one business/product observation, zero models and at most six rasters. Actual PID, endpoint deadline, phase/config/output, held process/pipes/exit, saved Owner CLOSE and actual socket bytes are checked.

The full execution path-to-SHA map is checked against FROZEN. It is distinct from the four scene/camera/capture/product_binding aliases. Actual input paths/hashes, prompt, fixed product, current Owner inputs and preparation ledger entries are matched.

Omitted empty region/image/pixel tables and coverage collections decode as the registered empty values. Independent cardinality and identity checks follow. Partial readable pixel rows remain separate from complete-witness rows.

Public ROI labels bind through object/host/name/source triangles and reconstructed quad/front. Equivalent u/v bases are accepted. Public source binding matches the compacted raw binding, and full actual camera specifications and frame poses match frozen cameras.

There is no requirement that opaque ref strings or the fixed session_id differ between qualification and formal. Current evidence is established by actual Owner/PID/output/cache/phase ledger and current PNG/NPZ/MCP receipt bindings.

Explicit ProductFactError is handled inside the semantic call as product_incorrect. Other missing/corrupt/unbound evidence errors produce evidence_failed. Ordinary product_errors also produce product_incorrect, and an otherwise correct but absent discriminating pattern produces not_realized. Only qualified sets passed=true.

Final normalization/scoring requires target world center, a complete readable current witness, its public pixel index, surface/boundary counts and a target-owned pixel. Full supported/remaining/unsupported sets, finite scope and actual source quotations are separately checked.

The saved reader accepts default include_images=true for empty active arguments and rejects false/unknown arguments. Formal reading permits repeated observations, while the qualification wrapper continues requiring exactly one active call. Supplemental native work is classified from actual code/data rather than tool name.

preparation_corrections.issue: Empty brief-v4 collections were initially indexed as mandatory keys.
preparation_corrections.resolution: The semantic reader now honors registered omitted-empty table and coverage semantics before independent checks.
A dedicated inner catch preserves product_incorrect and the outer evidence-failure handler covers corrupt archives and decoding errors.

preparation_corrections.issue: An earlier root read suggested cleanup/PID aliases were missing.
preparation_corrections.resolution: The final producer already emits canonical and alias fields. The final verifier uses canonical fields and validates aliases when present. No qualification execution failed because of this earlier static interpretation.

preparation_corrections.issue: The initial scoring draft left target point/location and explicit remaining declarations incomplete.
preparation_corrections.resolution: The final contract and scorer require target-owned pixel, world center and supported remaining-set declarations, with source-backed claims.

review_preparation_errors.detail: Two private JSON files were read before their author created them. Both later finalized files were read and hash-bound.
Two attempted verifier patch operations were rejected before mutation. The authorized verifier was then written successfully. No candidate execution occurred.

limits: This is static preparation. No new case qualification or formal consumer result exists in this review.
The private truth remains its original3606 hash. Prior decoder checks are saved preparation evidence and were not rerun here.
The final fixed case supports only the planned complete/readable discrimination and does not establish general-scene or speed/token benefit.
